instruction: I would like to copy all the numbers in the 'Old ID' column to the 'New 7 Digit Id' column, and pad them with zeros in front, to fill them up to seven digits. Finish the work and don't touch irrelevant regions, even if they are blank.

traj.action:
pyautogui.write('Sub FillNewId()
    Dim oDoc As Object
    Dim oSheet As Object
    Dim oCell As Object
    Dim oldIdCol As Integer
    Dim newIdCol As Integer
    Dim headerRow As Integer
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim oldVal As String
    Dim newVal As String
    
    oDoc = ThisComponent
    oSheet = oDoc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)
    
    ' Find header row and columns by scanning row 0
    Dim found As Boolean
    Dim oldIdColIdx As Integer
    Dim newIdColIdx As Integer
    oldIdColIdx = -1
    newIdColIdx = -1
    
    Dim r As Integer
    Dim c As Integer
    For r = 0 To 10
        For c = 0 To 20
            Dim cellStr As String
            cellStr = Trim(oSheet.getCellByPosition(c, r).getString())
            If InStr(LCase(cellStr), "old id") > 0 Or LCase(cellStr) = "old id" Then
                oldIdColIdx = c
            End If
            If InStr(LCase(cellStr), "new 7") > 0 Or InStr(LCase(cellStr), "new7") > 0 Then
                newIdColIdx = c
            End If
        Next c
        If oldIdColIdx >= 0 And newIdColIdx >= 0 Then
            headerRow = r
            Exit For
        End If
    Next r
    
    If oldIdColIdx < 0 Or newIdColIdx < 0 Then
        MsgBox "Could not find columns!"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' Find last row with data in Old ID column
    lastRow = headerRow + 1
    Do While oSheet.getCellByPosition(oldIdColIdx, lastRow).getString() <> ""
        lastRow = lastRow + 1
    Loop
    lastRow = lastRow - 1
    
    ' Fill New 7 Digit Id column
    For i = headerRow + 1 To lastRow
        oldVal = Trim(oSheet.getCellByPosition(oldIdColIdx, i).getString())
        If oldVal <> "" Then
            ' Remove any decimal part if number
            If InStr(oldVal, ".") > 0 Then
                oldVal = Left(oldVal, InStr(oldVal, ".") - 1)
            End If
            newVal = String(7 - Len(oldVal), "0") & oldVal
            Dim newCell As Object
            newCell = oSheet.getCellByPosition(newIdColIdx, i)
            newCell.setString(newVal)
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Save the file
    oDoc.store()
    
    MsgBox "Done! Filled rows " & (headerRow + 2) & " to " & (lastRow + 1)
End Sub', interval=0.05); time.sleep(0.5)

pyautogui.write('python3 << 'EOF'
import openpyxl

filepath = None
import glob
files = glob.glob('/home/user/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True) + glob.glob('/root/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True)
if files:
    filepath = files[0]
    print(f"Using file: {filepath}")
else:
    print("File not found!")
    exit(1)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(filepath)
ws = wb.active

# Find header row and column indices
old_id_col = None
new_id_col = None
header_row = None

for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value and 'old id' in str(cell.value).lower():
            old_id_col = cell.column
            header_row = cell.row
        if cell.value and 'new 7' in str(cell.value).lower():
            new_id_col = cell.column
    if old_id_col and new_id_col:
        break

print(f"Header row: {header_row}, Old ID col: {old_id_col}, New 7 Digit Id col: {new_id_col}")

# Fill in the new 7 digit id column
for row_num in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    old_cell = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=old_id_col)
    new_cell = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=new_id_col)
    if old_cell.value is not None and str(old_cell.value).strip() != '':
        old_val = str(int(float(str(old_cell.value))))
        new_val = old_val.zfill(7)
        new_cell.value = new_val
        print(f"Row {row_num}: {old_val} -> {new_val}")

wb.save(filepath)
print("File saved successfully!")
EOF', interval=0.05); time.sleep(0.5)
